head_semantics_note: source_git_head records the proved source state. Generated-only artifact commits may advance repository HEAD without changing the source state that the receipts prove.
claim_scope_label: Whole-project gold is blocked unless every listed plane, including memorial public-origin experience, is proven.
operator_summary: EA release control or required supporting receipts are blocked.
rules: EA flagship readiness does not imply whole Chummer project readiness.
Unknown external planes block whole-project gold claims.
Whole-project gold requires every listed plane to pass; EA receipt-set gold is only a narrower local label.
External Chummer receipts may promote their own plane from unknown to pass when they are present and passing.
Draft/operator LTD lanes cannot be treated as runtime or publication truth.
Telegram video delivery requires a dedicated live delivery receipt before it can support whole-project gold.
Design mirror parity is bounded; canonical product/UI proof must come from owning repos.
Memorial voice/realtime readiness requires its own browser, STT, TTS, and latency receipts.
Memorial public-origin gold requires the public voice roundtrip receipt, public browser realtime receipt, and public room-audio receipt.

planes.title: Executive Assistant Release Control
planes.claim: EA core workspace and release-control proof are green only when the EA receipt, weekly pulse, and browser workflow proof are green.
missing_evidence: weekly release_health=blocked: The EA flagship receipt is blocked by the current browser workflow proof or release evidence.
weekly flagship_readiness=blocked: Browser workflow proof is currently blocked, so the flagship receipt cannot support wider release claims.
weekly launch_readiness: Hold launch expansion pending browser execution proof and cross-host journey coverage.

planes.title: Fleet Journey Gates
planes.claim: Fleet journey gates are separate evidence; EA only consumes their generated summary.

planes.title: Design Surface And Mirror Boundary
planes.claim: EA owns a bounded mirror and cannot infer all Chummer product design readiness from mirrored docs alone.
missing_evidence: canonical Chummer product/UI design review receipt from the owning design repo
public/human-facing Chummer documentation humanization review receipt
desktop/public surface visual polish acceptance receipt from the owning UI repo
design_notes: Whole-project design gold requires canonical product/UI review receipts outside the EA mirror.
The EA mirror may be green while product-wide visual polish remains unproven.

planes.title: Chummer Core Rules And Data Correctness
planes.claim: Chummer core rules/data correctness is accepted only when the external rule-authority gold and completion receipts pass.

planes.title: Chummer Desktop/UI Product Surface
planes.claim: Desktop/UI readiness is accepted only when executable, visual familiarity, and layout hard-gate receipts pass.

planes.title: Chummer Hub And Public Web
planes.claim: Hub/public web readiness is accepted only when flagship readiness, public origin reachability, and shell clickability receipts pass.

planes.title: Mobile And Second-Device Continuation
planes.claim: Mobile readiness is accepted only when the Chummer play/mobile local release proof passes.

planes.title: Media Factory And Video Publication
planes.claim: Published Black Ledger live media is accepted when its live media proof passes; future provider candidates remain draft/operator until asset-specific receipts exist.
missing_evidence: asset-specific media factory publication receipt for each promoted video/horizon asset
provider candidate promotion receipt before MagicFit, JoggAI, Poppy, or avatar lanes can count as publication proof
human publication approval receipt for generated media leaving the operator lab
design_notes: This is a bounded publication pass for current Black Ledger live media, not a blanket promotion of MagicFit, JoggAI, Poppy, or avatar candidate lanes.

planes.title: Telegram Video Delivery
planes.claim: Telegram video replies are accepted only when source-video download safety, governed render lanes, durable delivery receipts, and live operator message-ID proof are present.
design_notes: Local source-video edits can be a bounded operator lane.
MagicFit remains disabled unless the runtime lane is explicitly approved and the Docker image is digest pinned.
Generated bounded proof is not the same as a live Telegram delivery receipt.

planes.title: Memorial Voice / Realtime Demo
planes.claim: Memorial local voice release can pass separately from Memorial public-origin gold. Manfred remains local memories/conversation only, with no internet search.
design_notes: Public copy must not collapse this into a generic gold claim.
public-origin room/device audio intelligibility receipt with manual attestation
public origin is still deployed in EA_CORE mode instead of MEMORIAL mode

planes.title: Memorial Public-Origin Experience Gold
planes.claim: The public memorial experience is gold only when the deployed public origin proves the voice roundtrip receipt, browser realtime playback with live STT, room/device intelligibility, and latency. Local release receipts do not satisfy this plane.
missing_evidence: public-origin room/device audio intelligibility receipt with manual attestation
public origin is still deployed in EA_CORE mode instead of MEMORIAL mode
design_notes: Guest-facing copy must never say simply gold while this plane is blocked.

planes.title: LTD Provider Lanes
planes.claim: Provider lanes may be verified runtime, draft/operator, or parked inventory; they are not product truth.
